contract.summary: Fix the pytest 5.2.3 regression by preventing recursively discovered package initializers from being imported unless they are selected for collection. An initializer is selected when it matches the configured python_files patterns or is passed explicitly. A recursively encountered, unselected __init__.py must not be imported, but matching test files beneath its directory must still be discovered and executed. Preserving the existing internal Package collector hierarchy for unselected initializers is not required.
